Digital Nomad Visa – Work Remotely While Living Abroad

Dreaming of working from a beach in Portugal, a café in Spain, or a mountain town in Italy? A Digital Nomad Visa makes it possible for eligible remote workers, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and online business owners to live abroad while continuing to work for clients or employers outside their host country.

At Starfish Travel Co., we help travelers understand international visa options and stay informed about the latest immigration updates.

What is a Digital Nomad Visa?

A Digital Nomad Visa is a long-stay visa offered by several countries that allows eligible remote professionals to legally live in the country while earning income from overseas.

Benefits of a Digital Nomad Visa

✔️ Live and work legally in another country
✔️ Long-term stay opportunities (country-specific)
✔️ Ideal for freelancers, remote employees, consultants, and entrepreneurs
✔️ Experience a better work-life balance
✔️ Explore new cultures while continuing your career
